Only 23% of 4,441 remote job listings reveal pay. Here's what that means for your job search.

Our latest data from Loker Dollar shows that out of 4,441 active remote listings, just 1,000 (23%) include a salary or hourly figure. The rest keep compensation private. But that doesn't necessarily mean low wages—many firms expect candidates to negotiate.

Key findings:
- 2,753 listings (62%) are open to worldwide applicants.
- Communication is the top required skill (39% of listings), followed by AI (12%) and leadership (10%).
- 1,427 engineering roles are open, with 276 posted this week.
- Only one company, Neo Financial, discloses pay at $5 USD/hour.

If you're an Indonesian job seeker looking for USD remote jobs, use the "worldwide remote" filter to find roles that accept applicants from anywhere. The full breakdown is on our blog.

Read more: https://lokerdollar.com/en/blog/global-remote-jobs-2026
